## Highlights

- Adds a Windows x64 installer and portable archive with bundled Java and GStreamer runtimes.
- Enforces exclusive AirPlay session ownership with guarded source teardown and reconnect handling.
- Supports H.264 mirroring with ALAC/AAC-ELD audio and opt-in experimental HEVC reception.
- Adds resilient application shutdown, settings validation and restart, system-tray controls, display-awake handling, and GPU adapter selection.
- Adds the FFplay video backend while retaining the shared GStreamer audio path.

## Validation

- Automated JVM, native GStreamer, Windows packaging, portable archive, installer, shortcut, ACL, and uninstall checks passed.
- Real-device validation covered H.264 video, AAC-ELD audio, AMD D3D12 hardware decoding with automatic and explicit adapter selection, rapid reconnects, settings restart, tray exit, and detached-window codec updates.
- A real Windows uninstall removed application files, shortcuts, and the uninstall registration while preserving the per-user configuration and receiver identity.

## Real-device coverage notes

The following are validation gaps, not known failures:

- **HEVC:** the receiver capability and native decoding pipeline were tested, but the available iOS sender continued to negotiate H.264. Real-device HEVC playback was therefore not covered.
- **ALAC:** ALAC parsing and playback paths have automated coverage, but the available iOS sender negotiated AAC-ELD. Real-device ALAC playback was therefore not covered.
- **Two-device takeover:** ownership and takeover behavior have automated regression coverage, but a real takeover between two simultaneous physical AirPlay senders was not performed because only one iOS sender was available.
